gap: The fold stacks four separate small-type registers in the left column before the reader reaches the button, and two of them are the same treatment in two different hues: the eyebrow FOR BUSINESSES EVERYWHERE is letterspaced caps at a 17px device cap band in violet rgb(109,40,217), and YOUR WORKSPACE URL 435px below it is letterspaced caps at a 16px device cap band in navy rgb(13,27,94). Identical typographic register, two meanings, two colours, so the caps treatment stops meaning anything. Wave's fold carries exactly one caps register (its violet eyebrow) and nothing else in that size. Fix: keep the violet caps for the section eyebrow only, and demote the form label to sentence-case navy at body-micro size (or drop it, since the .paperandpen.om suffix inside the field already states the job), then merge the star rating into the microcopy weight so the column runs rating-micro, eyebrow-caps, h1, lede, field, button instead of four competing label voices.
